description:
What is This Part?
This is the Steering Knuckle Repair kit
This kit will repair BOTH knuckleS (left & right sides)
Comes with King Pin Shim to re-adjust King Pin once completed.
NOTE: Color of Oil Seal may vary
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Kit – (Does LH or RH Side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
